# AI Agent를 지휘하는 마케터

> 박충효가 제안하는 Command Marketing 실무 가이드. 마케터가 AI Agent에게 업무를 맡기고, 결과를 검수하고, 사람과 Agent의 역할을 운영 체계로 설계하는 방법을 다룹니다.

## Canonical URL

- https://saewookkangboy.github.io/commandaiagent/

## Primary facts

- Title: AI Agent를 지휘하는 마케터
- Author: 박충효
- Organization: TROE
- Language: Korean
- Length: 320 pages
- Structure: 7 parts and a 21-day practice plan
- Core framework: R-G-C-T-O-R — Role, Goal, Context, Tool, Output, Review
- Main concept: Command Marketing — humans set goals and review criteria while AI Agents support repeatable execution

## Main topics

- AI Agent literacy and governance
- Marketing research and strategy Agents
- Content and creative Agents
- Advertising, CRM, and performance Agents
- Marketing AX and human-AI collaboration
- Reusable AI marketing operating systems
